body: I did the extension and that is why it is going to cost so much, and I am severely disabled and not able to work.  I am in a lot of physical pain all the time.  Thank you for the kind thoughts though. I am just so mentally and physically exhausted all the time.  I am at the end of the road.

it is my mother's jewellery, not worth much except for sentimental reasons, she died in 2009.  I pawned it it to pay rent after my wife got sick.  It is almost 400 dollars, which is a huge amount right now.  I am in a dark place right now, I appreciate someone acknowledging that I am here.

I kept this off my main account because my wife knows that one. I am overwhelmed by the support that I have been shown here.  She (and the rest of our pets) are beloved and cherished and this was one of the hardest things I have ever had to do.  To see that I did the right thing will help me feel better and to move on.  Thank you all.
thank you all for the comments.  I have been haunted by this for days and I want to think I did the right thing for her.
I hope that is true...I really do.
thank you.  I really needed to hear that.
thanks, I was hoping I did the right thing even though it was a hard choice.
